standing_rule: SHARE THE RECORD, NEVER SHARE THE CLAIM: a claim carries rids, places and small values only; the record is the dictionary store's
records_live_in: dictionary store v1 records, one file per M id (relay v78; the v1.1 claims and indexes, relay v79); a rid is the first 16 hex of the record id

definitions.span_record: A SPAN RECORD = the dictionary record (rid) of a v1.4 row: v1.3 rows by span-rows.jsonl; the 50 v1.4 rows by (M id, the row's source file and locator) against the dictionary records' (file, loc) — 0 unmapped or each named as a negative with why (a row whose entry is no dictionary record stays a labelled negative, never a claim).
definitions.span_place: A SPAN PLACE (claim) = { book, ref, w_first, w_last (page numbering, w_page), ink_key (letters joined by the ink's gaps), rids (the records that stand here, in v1.4's row_ids order), kinds (per rid: SPAN | WELD), gap (per rid: the source's gap SPACE | MAQAF | NONE), same_entry (per weld rid: the v1.4 label at this place), inside_of, contains, overlaps (ink keys), by: "lane" }; claims/places/<book>.jsonl sorted by (ref, w_first).
definitions.index_by_key: INDEX by_key: ink key → rids (names first, as v1.4's order), and per key its place count; index/by-key.jsonl.

invariants.I1: every rid resolves to one dictionary record
invariants.I2: every v1.4 row stands as a rid in exactly the places v1.4 gives it (0 differences) or as a named negative
invariants.I4: every place's w_first..w_last are consecutive page words whose letters joined by the ink's gaps equal ink_key

instruction_lines: I1. Underline a span only where this store’s places file holds the ink’s place: the span’s letters joined by the gap as the ink writes it, at that verse and those word numbers.
I2. Draw each row the place’s row_ids name as one line, one blob and one card over all its words, with the row’s R, M and D; where a place names several rows, one pill per row, each with its own M.
I3. Where a place lies inside or across another place, draw both; the places file marks it.
I4. Take the licence pill from the licence ledger by the row’s m id.
what_a_row_is: a dictionary record (rid) v2 names at a place, read from the served dictionary store: its R, D, M and headwords are that record's own bytes
ink_key: A SPAN PLACE (claim) = { book, ref, w_first, w_last (page numbering, w_page), ink_key (letters joined by the ink's gaps), rids (the records that stand here, in v1.4's row_ids order), kinds (per rid: SPAN | WELD), gap (per rid: the source's gap SPACE | MAQAF | NONE), same_entry (per weld rid: the v1.4 label at this place), inside_of, contains, overlaps (ink keys), by: "lane" }; claims/places/<book>.jsonl sorted by (ref, w_first).
by_key_rule: ink key -> rids as v2's index/by-key.jsonl orders them (names first, v1.4's order), less the rids withheld (WELD) and held

rows.what: served: the rids received less those withheld and held

rids_weld_withheld.what: WELD rids (a closed-up entry across a maqaf), withheld by the no-weld rule

rids_held.what: rows v1.4 added, held until the lane chooses a reading per place

rids_read_from_v1_4_rows.what: the reading is v1.4's row for the record, through row-to-rid

rids_read_from_the_record.what: no v1.4 row: the record's own R

rids_unread.what: no R on the record and no v1.4 row: not served
